python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
import re
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema, fields
class Payload(Schema):
    created_at = fields.DateTime(format="rfc")
spec = APISpec(title="RFC example", version="1.0", openapi_version="3.0.0", plugins=[MarshmallowPlugin()])
spec.components.schema("Payload", schema=Payload)
field = spec.to_dict()["components"]["schemas"]["Payload"]["properties"]["created_at"]
print("example:", field["example"])
print("pattern:", field["pattern"])
print("matches:", bool(re.fullmatch(field["pattern"], field["example"])))
assert re.fullmatch(field["pattern"], field["example"])
PYREPLAY
